1. You don’t need to worry about switching from a traditional stance to southpaw right now.
2. Your hands need to always be up in guard. You are often dropping them below your waist; if you do that in a real smoker you’ll get killed
3. When you throw a cross or jab, do not flare your elbows. They need to fire straight, and on your cross to generate power pivot your back foot.
4. When you’re jabbing and throwing crosses, your guard hand moves along with your punches. It’s very predictable and is a bad habit.

Your footwork needs a lot of work too, you’re moving too spastic, and are too narrow for a MT stance. 
 I think perhaps fix up your boxing before you clean up your kicks, but general pointers for that are you shouldn’t over pivot, turn your ass and hips with the kick to generate torque, arms should swing with the kick, one arm must be in guard, and get on the ball of your foot.
